instruction: typography is not the same. Please check all country pages and implement the following: 1. Use a shared CSS component — explicitly define the font features for the .metrics container and its children instead of relying on inherited styles. 2. Implement CSS variables (design tokens) for the metric font family, value size and bold weight. 3. Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for the data figures. 4. Component-based architecture — wrap this logic inside a single MetricButton component so the HTML structure and associated styles are bundled together and reused identically everywhere.
objective: Hero metric panels render identical typography on every country page: explicit font declarations on .metrics and its children, design tokens for family/size/weight, tabular figures, and one MetricButton component used by both the Portugal hero and the data-driven hero.
requiredChanges: explicit font declarations on .metrics and its children in src/styles/country-template.css
design tokens for the metric font family, value size and bold weight
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on the metric value
a single MetricButton component imported by every hero variant
